info.title: InfoPanel engine API
info.summary: The engine's requests on the loopback interface: its REST API under /api, the preview socket, the health check, the sign-in link and pairing under /auth/pairing.
info.description: An index of the engine API: every request, its parameters, and each status it answers with its media type and body. Bodies are definitions of the schemas in schemas/ (urn:infopanel:api:1), referred to by id; docs/api.md and docs/commit.md specify the behaviour. info.version is the API's protocol, as GET /api/session reports it (docs/versioning.md#the-engine-api).

servers.description: A running engine: on the port it was started with, else a free one, which it writes to runtime.json in its data folder.

get.summary: The engine, this run of it and what it supports.

200.description: The session.

get.summary: The font families a scene's text can name.

200.description: The engine's own families first, then the system's, each sorted, each once whatever its case.

get.summary: Every sensor the engine's sources offer, with its status now.

200.description: The sensors.

get.summary: Every sensor source the engine runs, in the order it asks them, with its state now and why.

200.description: The sources, each listed even when it offers no sensors.

get.summary: The reading of every listed sensor that has one now.

parameters.name: history
parameters.description: How many of each number sensor's last samples to add, clamped to 0–4,096; 0 when absent.

200.description: The readings, in list order.

get.summary: The picture an image sensor's reading names, as its source holds it (the sensors.image feature).

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: The reference the sensor's reading names (sensorValue.text), once.

200.description: The picture's bytes exactly as the source holds them, at most 8 MiB, in its format's media type; Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: `key` or `ref` absent, empty or given more than once, `key` over 512 characters or `ref` over 2,048.

404.description: No picture to answer: no image sensor under `key`, no picture held under `ref`, or one that isn't a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP within the media limits and 8 MiB.

get.summary: The engine settings in effect, with their version and whether the engine could read them.

200.description: The settings.

patch.summary: Changes the settings the body names, stores them and answers the settings in effect.

200.description: The change is stored (or changed nothing); the settings in effect.

409.description: The engine couldn't read its stored settings when it started, or they are another major version's: it changes none until they are fixed or removed and it restarts. Nothing was changed.

422.description: The body breaks its definition or a limit (limit.settingsRequestBytes, limit.settingsDepth, limit.settingsClientBytes), or the settings it makes would be over a limit (limit.settingsClients, limit.settingsBytes); nothing was changed.

503.description: `storeUnavailable`: the change would change the service's address, and the store couldn't remove the credential kept for the old one (docs/api.md#the-configured-service). The settings weren't changed.

get.summary: The configured service's address, the state of the credential a client provides for it (never the credential) and of the connection AI apps elsewhere use.

200.description: The address, the credential's state, where it is kept, a fingerprint of the stored credential, and the state of the connection AI apps elsewhere use (docs/api.md#ai-apps-elsewhere).

put.summary: Keeps a credential a client provides for the configured service, in place of any the engine has.

204.description: The credential is kept; its state is `present`.

409.description: `noService`: the engine has no service address, so it keeps no credential. Nothing was changed.

422.description: The body breaks its definition or its limit (limit.requestBytes): a credential that isn't an RFC 6750 token or is over 4,096 characters. Nothing was changed.

503.description: `storeUnavailable`: the store refused to keep the credential. The credential the engine had, if any, is kept as it was.

delete.summary: Removes the credential the engine keeps for the configured service, if any.

204.description: The engine keeps no credential (it had none, or it removed it).

503.description: `storeUnavailable`: the store couldn't remove the credential; the engine keeps it as it was.

get.summary: The engine's recent log entries after a given one, oldest first.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `seq` of the last entry the client has: only newer entries are answered. Every kept entry when absent.

200.description: The entries and the newest entry's seq.

400.description: `after` isn't a whole number from 0 to 9,007,199,254,740,991 in decimal digits, or is given more than once.

post.summary: Installs the PawnIO driver from the installer bundled with the engine; Windows asks for administrator rights once.
post.description: docs/api.md#the-pawnio-driver. No body: the engine runs its own installer with fixed arguments.

202.description: The install started: the driver's state is `installing` until it ends (after `installed`, until the engine has read the driver again and started a new sensor helper for it), and its outcome is then the driver's `lastInstall` (GET /api/sensors/sources).

409.description: No install started: one runs already (the driver's state is `installing`, which after an install that ended `installed` lasts until the engine has read the driver again and started a new sensor helper for it), or the engine has no bundled installer to run (not Windows, a replay, a build without it, or one whose SHA-256 isn't the one the engine pins).

post.summary: Sets up reading all sensors: a task that runs the sensor helper as SYSTEM for the engine's user; Windows asks for administrator rights once.
post.description: docs/api.md#reading-all-sensors. No body: the engine runs its own sensor helper with fixed arguments.

202.description: The change started: the state is `settingUp` until it ends, and its outcome is then `lastChange` (GET /api/sensors/sources).

409.description: No change started: one runs already, or there is nothing to set up here (not Windows, a replay, the engine elevated, or not installed under Program Files).

delete.summary: Turns reading all sensors off: removes the engine's user's task; Windows asks for administrator rights once.

202.description: The change started: the state is `settingUp` until it ends, and its outcome is then `lastChange` (GET /api/sensors/sources).

409.description: No change started: one runs already, or there is nothing to set up here (not Windows, a replay, the engine elevated, or not installed under Program Files).

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Which of the engine's own folders: `data`, its data folder (the session's dataDir); `logs`, the folder of its log files; or `plugins`, its data folder's `plugins/`, where the plugins a user adds go, created when absent (the `plugins` feature, docs/api.md#plugins).

post.summary: Opens one of the engine's own folders in the file manager of the computer it runs on.

204.description: The engine asked the system's file manager to open the folder; a repeat within a second, or a request while four file managers it started haven't exited, asks nothing and is answered the same (docs/api.md#folders).

404.description: No such folder: `folder` isn't `data`, `logs` or `plugins`. The engine opens no other path.

500.description: The engine couldn't open the folder: it isn't there, or the file manager couldn't be started. The error is in the engine's log.

get.summary: Whether the engine hosts plugins, and each plugin package it found: its state, its plugins, its errors (the `plugins` feature).

200.description: The packages; none, and `enabled` false, when the engine was started without plugins. Never a setting's value.

put.summary: Turns a plugin package on or off: the choice is written, kept across restarts, then its host started or stopped.

200.description: The choice is written and its host started (the package `starting`) or stopped (`off`); turning on a package that is on and failed starts it again; a choice it already has changes nothing.

404.description: No package in that folder (none at all when the engine was started without plugins).

409.description: The package is `unsupported` (it doesn't run on this operating system), or the engine couldn't read its plugin state file when it started and changes none this run (docs/api.md#turning-a-package-on-or-off). Nothing was changed.

500.description: The choice couldn't be written; nothing was changed. The error is in the engine's log.

post.summary: Restarts a plugin package's host: stopped (5 seconds, then killed), then started afresh, its restarts counted anew.

202.description: Its host was stopped and is starting again: the package, `starting`.

404.description: No package in that folder (none at all when the engine was started without plugins).

409.description: The package is turned off, or `unsupported`.

post.summary: Opens a plugin package's folder (a bundled one's too) in the file manager of the computer the engine runs on.

204.description: The engine asked the system's file manager to open the folder, as POST /api/folders/{folder}/open does (docs/api.md#folders).

404.description: No package in that folder (none at all when the engine was started without plugins).

500.description: The engine couldn't open the folder; the error is in its log.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: The action, as the plugin lists it (pluginAction's `method`).

post.summary: Asks a plugin to run one of the actions it lists, through its package's host as it runs then.

202.description: The request was sent to the host; the engine doesn't wait for the action. An error it meets is the package's (pluginPackage's `errors`).

404.description: No package in that folder, its running host lists no plugin with that id, or the plugin lists no action of that name. The engine sends no other.

409.description: The package's host isn't running.

get.summary: A plugin's settings, each with its value, asked of its package's host as it runs.

200.description: Every setting, as the plugin answers them.

404.description: No package in that folder, its running host lists no plugin with that id, or the plugin has no settings.

409.description: The package's host isn't running, or didn't answer within 10 seconds.

patch.summary: Changes one of a plugin's settings: checked against the setting, applied by the plugin as it runs and kept by its host.

200.description: Every setting, as the plugin answers them once it applied the change (one change can change others).

404.description: No package in that folder, its running host lists no plugin with that id, the plugin has no settings, or none with that key.

409.description: The package's host isn't running, or didn't answer within 10 seconds.

422.description: The body breaks its definition or `requestBytes`, or its value isn't one the setting takes (`setting.value` at /value: of another type, a whole number outside int32, outside the setting's `min` and `max`, not finite, not one of its `options`, or text over 4,096 characters); nothing was changed.

get.summary: The computer's displays, the primary one first, each in the shape a profile's window.display takes.

200.description: The displays, read when the request came; none, and `supported` false, where the engine doesn't show desktop windows.

500.description: The engine couldn't list the displays: the system didn't answer within 5 seconds, or failed. The error is in the engine's log.

get.summary: The USB panels the engine has saved, in the order it first saw them, with their state, settings and the list's version, and the panel families it knows (the devices feature).

200.description: The saved panels; none, and `supported` false with its `reason`, where the engine drives no panels this run.

post.summary: Saves a panel that need not be plugged in, with its model, serial when known, the 1.x device it is brought over from, and settings (the devices feature).

409.description: A saved panel has the 1.x device id (ignoring case), or the family and serial, the save names (existsProblem, with the saved panel's id); or the engine drives no panels this run, couldn't read its devices file when it started, or couldn't write it (problem). Nothing was saved.

422.description: The body breaks its definition or `requestBytes`, or names a family the engine doesn't know, built in or a panel package's (`device.family` at /family), a model the family doesn't have (`device.model` at /model) or a setting the family doesn't honour (`device.setting` at /settings/{name}); nothing was saved.

patch.summary: Changes a panel's settings: the ones given are merged into its own, saved, and applied at once (the devices feature).

200.description: Saved and applied: the panel's entry.

404.description: No such device (none at all where the engine drives no panels).

409.description: The engine couldn't read its devices file when it started: it changes no device this run and leaves the file as it is. Nothing was changed.

422.description: The body breaks its definition or `requestBytes` (a value out of range included), or names a setting the device's family doesn't honour (`device.setting` at /settings/{name}); nothing was changed.

delete.summary: Forgets a panel: its screen turned off, its settings removed; plugged in, it comes back as a new panel (the devices feature).

404.description: No such device (none at all where the engine drives no panels).

409.description: The engine couldn't read its devices file when it started: it forgets no device this run and leaves the file as it is.

get.summary: Every profile, in display order.

200.description: The profiles.

post.summary: Creates a profile under a client-chosen id, empty or from a document.

409.description: A profile with the id exists; nothing was created.

get.summary: The profile's current document and its state.

200.description: The document.

delete.summary: Deletes the profile, whatever its status, with its document and history, when the request names its tag.

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: The document's tag, from its profile entry or document: another profile created under the id meanwhile isn't deleted.

400.description: No instance, or not exactly one of 1–64 characters; checked before anything else.

409.description: The instance isn't the profile's tag (deleteConflictProblem, one instance conflict): nothing was deleted.

post.summary: Copies the profile's current document under a client-chosen id.

409.description: A profile with the new id exists (existsProblem), or this one can't be opened (profileStatusProblem); nothing was created.

get.summary: The profile's document, to keep or to create a profile from elsewhere.

200.description: The profile's current document without its rev members, scenes and opaque members as stored.

409.description: The profile can't be opened (profileStatusProblem): it isn't exported.

get.summary: The profile as a profile archive (.infopanel2): its manifest, its document and every blob it refers to.

200.description: The archive, with Content-Disposition naming it.

409.description: The profile can't be opened (profileStatusProblem), or its archive would be one its import refuses (exportProblem): no archive is made.

get.summary: A PNG of the current document.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: The width in pixels, clamped to 16–4,096; 320 when absent.

200.description: The thumbnail.

post.summary: Applies ops to the document, all or none, as one undo step.

200.description: The commit's result.

409.description: The profile can't be opened (profileStatusProblem), an op conflicts (conflictProblem), or the commit is too old to tell from a retry (expiredProblem); nothing was applied.

post.summary: Undoes the last undo step.

200.description: The document's state after the step.

409.description: The profile can't be opened (profileStatusProblem), or the request names another document's tag or the document changed since baseRev (conflictProblem); nothing was applied.

post.summary: Redoes the last undone step.

200.description: The document's state after the step.

409.description: The profile can't be opened (profileStatusProblem), or the request names another document's tag or the document changed since baseRev (conflictProblem); nothing was applied.

post.summary: Returns the document to its saved state, as one undo step.

200.description: The document's state after the step.

409.description: The profile can't be opened (profileStatusProblem), or the request names another document's tag or the document changed since baseRev (conflictProblem); nothing was applied.

post.summary: Saves the document as it is when the save starts.

requestBody.description: Optional: the document's tag and the revision to save. Without a body the save isn't guarded.

200.description: The document's state once the write is done.

409.description: The profile can't be opened (profileStatusProblem), or the body names another document's tag or the document changed since baseRev (conflictProblem); nothing was saved.

post.summary: Stores bytes as a blob, named by their SHA-256, and inspects them as media.

requestBody.description: The bytes, of any content type.

200.description: The bytes were already stored.

413.description: The bytes are over videoBytes; nothing was stored.

200.description: The blob is stored; Content-Length is its size.

get.summary: The blob's bytes, exactly as stored.

200.description: The bytes.

post.summary: Opens a profile archive (.infopanel2): checks it, stores its blobs and answers its document; creates nothing.

requestBody.description: The archive's bytes, of any content type.

200.description: The archive's document, the blobs it carried (stored) and the ones it lacks.

413.description: The bytes are over archiveBytes; nothing was read or stored.

422.description: The archive breaks a guard or its format (archive.*), needs a newer engine (unsupported.*, under /manifest or /document), breaks a limit (limit.*) or holds a document a create would refuse (under /document): nothing is created, and only blobs verified before the refusal may be stored.

get.summary: The 1.x migration: its state, the 1.x folder and, when it has 1.x data, its profiles, settings and diagnostics.

200.description: The migration's state.

put.summary: Stores what a migration did as the run-once record, replacing any record, and answers the new state.

200.description: The record is stored; the migration's state, now done.

422.description: The body breaks its definition or a limit (limit.recordBytes, limit.recordOutcomes); nothing was stored.

post.summary: Reads one profile of the 1.x folder into its envelope, storing its image files as blobs; installs nothing.

200.description: The profile's envelope.

422.description: The folder holds 1.1.x data, which isn't imported (import.version); nothing was stored.

post.summary: Reads a 1.x .infopanel file into its envelope, storing its image files as blobs; installs nothing.

requestBody.description: The file's bytes, of any content type.

200.description: The profile's envelope.

413.description: The bytes are over archiveBytes; nothing was read or stored.

422.description: The file breaks an archive guard (archive.*), isn't a 1.x profile export (import.archive, archive.v2) or its Profile.xml can't be read (import.xml); nothing was stored.

get.summary: The integration tokens, oldest first, without their secrets.

200.description: The tokens.

post.summary: Creates an integration token and answers its secret, once.

201.description: The new token and its secret.

422.description: The body breaks its definition or a limit, or the stored tokens would be over tokensBytes (limit.tokensBytes); nothing was created.

delete.summary: Revokes an integration token at once.

204.description: Revoked; the sockets opened with it are closed.

get.summary: The paired clients, oldest first, without their secrets.

200.description: The paired clients; a pairing another replaced isn't listed.

post.summary: Issues a one-time pairing code for a client on another computer.
post.description: docs/api.md#pairing. The code is exchanged once, within 2 minutes, at POST /auth/pairing/code.

201.description: The code, when it stops being usable, and the origins a client may exchange it from.

delete.summary: Removes a paired client's pairing, and the pairings it replaced.

204.description: Removed: the client no longer proves the pairing. A connection it has keeps the run's session token until the engine stops.

get.summary: The preview socket: a WebSocket with the subprotocol infopanel.v1.
get.description: docs/api.md#the-preview-socket. The upgrade takes no Authorization header: the token comes as the subprotocol auth.{token} or in the first message (authMessage).

101.description: Switching to the WebSocket: the engine sends serverMessage text messages and binary frames, the client clientMessage text messages.

401.description: No infopanel.v1 subprotocol, or an auth.{token} subprotocol whose token isn't valid.

get.summary: Whether the engine runs.

200.description: The text ok.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token from the sign-in link the engine prints.

parameters.name: then
parameters.description: The client's page the link lands on: only `#/settings/account`, once; any other is ignored.

get.summary: The sign-in link: hands the session token to the client served by the engine.

401.description: Any token but the session token.

post.summary: Exchanges a one-time pairing code, once, for the run's session token and a lasting pairing.
post.description: docs/api.md#pairing. Answered to a client served from another origin with CORS, as /api is.

201.description: The run's session token and instance, and the new pairing with its secret (absent when the engine can't keep pairings).

403.description: The code is unknown, expired or used before (one answer for all three); a second use also removes the pairing the first made.

post.summary: Exchanges a pass the configured service signed, once, for the run's session token and a lasting pairing.
post.description: docs/api.md#pairing-through-the-configured-service. Only while the service.pairing setting is on. Answered to a client served from another origin with CORS, as /api is.

201.description: The run's session token and instance, and the new pairing with its secret (absent when the engine can't keep pairings), as a code's exchange answers.

403.description: The pass is refused: `code` says why, in one word (`off` while the setting is off, whatever the body).

post.summary: A paired client's challenge: the engine proves first that it holds the pairing's secret, over its own port.
post.description: docs/api.md#pairing. Answered to a client served from another origin with CORS, as /api is.

200.description: The engine's nonce and proof; a replaced pairing's too.

404.description: The engine has no such pairing: removed, another data folder, or pairings it couldn't read.

post.summary: A paired client's proof: once it checks, the run's session token, with the engine's proof over it.
post.description: docs/api.md#pairing. Answered to a client served from another origin with CORS, as /api is.

200.description: The run's session token and instance, and the engine's proof over them.

403.description: A check failed: the challenge is gone, expired or another pairing's, the pairing was replaced or removed, or the proof doesn't check (one answer for all).

v1Id.name: v1Id
v1Id.description: The 1.x profile's Guid, as the migration's state lists it.

profileId.name: id
profileId.description: The profile's id: its document's id.

pluginFolder.name: folder
pluginFolder.description: The package's folder name (pluginPackage's `folder`), matched ignoring case.

blobId.name: id
blobId.description: The blob's id: sha256: and 64 lower-case hex digits.

badQuery.description: A query parameter isn't a whole number from −2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647.

unauthorized.description: No token, or one the engine doesn't know or has revoked.

forbidden.description: The token lacks the scope the request needs.

notFound.description: No such profile, blob or token.

profileStatus.description: The profile's document can't be opened: its status is unsupported or unreadable.

invalid.description: The body breaks its definition, the formats, a rule or a limit; nothing was applied.

pairingsUnreadable.description: The engine couldn't read its paired clients at start; it keeps none this run (docs/api.md#pairing).

bearer.description: The session token or an integration token: Authorization: Bearer {token}. A security requirement lists the scope the request needs: read, edit (which implies read) or session (the session token only).

socketToken.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
socketToken.description: The token as the subprotocol auth.{token}, offered with infopanel.v1; or, when no auth.* subprotocol is offered, as the first message (authMessage) within 5 seconds.
